moves.label: Quick Nano Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a short active window from Eve's morphing arm.
moves.reason: Compact upper-body poke with a nanotech arm shape.

moves.label: Low Hair Blade
moves.description: Fast low slash with long active hair-blade pressure along the legs.
moves.reason: The hair sweeps low through several blade-like frames.

moves.label: Nano Claw Check
moves.description: Quick mid check that angles forward with weak right-side tracking.
moves.reason: The contact frames show a forward claw or blade shape.

moves.label: Transform Rush
moves.description: Fast mid rush that blurs forward through a compact body transform.
moves.reason: Eve's body stretches into a fast horizontal rush.

moves.label: Winged Pierce
moves.description: Slow mid jumping strike that extends Eve's arm into a piercing lance.
moves.reason: The command has airborne winged posture and a long arm extension.

moves.label: Angel Wing Launcher
moves.description: Quick mid launcher that unfurls Eve's wings into an upward strike.
moves.reason: Winged frames and authored launcher property clearly fit a pop-up.

moves.label: Low Hair Feint
moves.description: Fast low feint that rolls Eve's hair-blade shape along the ground.
moves.reason: Low curling hair animation stays near the floor.

moves.label: Low Transform Sweep
moves.description: Fast low knockdown that stretches Eve into a sliding hair-blade sweep.
moves.reason: Long low transform sequence is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Nano Hammer Crush
moves.description: Slow mid tornado knockdown that morphs into a heavy hammer swing.
moves.reason: Hammer-like transform and authored tornado/knockdown support the role.

moves.label: Crouch Angel Sweep
moves.description: Fast mid crouch strike that rises into white wing-blade frames.
moves.reason: Full-crouch route starts low and unfolds into wing-blade shapes.

moves.label: Crouch Nano Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher from a crouched hair-blade rush.
moves.reason: Crouch command is authored as launcher and uses fast blade frames.

moves.label: Charged Nano Jab
moves.description: Fast high charged jab with even timing across startup and recovery.
moves.reason: Charge command reuses the quick high jab silhouette.

moves.label: Nano Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown that curls Eve's body into a powered transform rush.
moves.reason: Charge special shows a powered curl and knockdown data.

moves.label: While-Rising Hair Blade
moves.description: Steady mid while-standing blade rush with weak right-side tracking.
moves.reason: While-standing route uses the same hair-blade rush family.

moves.label: Rising Nano Lance
moves.description: Fast mid rising strike that extends Eve's arm into a long lance.
moves.reason: The frames show a long golden lance-like arm extension.

moves.label: Low-Step Nano Jab
moves.description: Fast high poke from a low command that still checks upper body.
moves.reason: The contact frames match the charged high jab family.

moves.label: Diagonal Nano Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that angles in with a right-tracking hair-blade rush.
moves.reason: d/f command is authored as launcher and uses weak-right blade rush frames.

moves.label: Forward Nano Check
moves.description: Slow mid forward check with a committed morphing-arm poke.
moves.reason: Forward route uses the compact arm-morph poke.

moves.label: Forward Hair Blade
moves.description: Steady mid forward blade rush with weak right-side tracking.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the hair-blade rush animation.

moves.label: Nano Dash Jab
moves.description: Fast high motion jab with balanced active and recovery timing.
moves.reason: qcf command reuses the high nano jab sequence.

moves.label: Golden Transform Burst
moves.description: Fast mid jumping knockdown that whips Eve through a large golden transform.
moves.reason: The finisher lifts and curls through a large golden transformed shape.
